title: Origins Aerelion
description: The official Aerelion Origin from the Lornwood SMP
body:
# The Aerelion Origin

## The official Origin from the Lornwood SMP now in its Public State

Required Mods

- [Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui) (for the size)
- [Apugli](https://modrinth.com/mod/apugli) (To be able to eat the Seeds)

Reminder this Origin is not the same as in the Lornwood SMP this Origin has been cleaned up for public use so some things might be tweaked a bit.

## Origin Info
For ingame view check the Gallery for a cleaner view

## Lore 
Free in the sky, flying high above the other creatures of the land. Your people are naturally lighthearted and playful, exploring the vast corners of the world and rejoicing in discovery

## Powers 

### Avian Diet
The way your mouth and organs are formed makes you only eat certain Seeds, Fruits and Fish.

### Claustrophobic
Without easy access to the sky, you become anxious and jumpy. You are slower and can't break blocks as easily when under blocks directly above your head.

### Dismount
You can throw your passengers off of you.

### Mountable
Carry other players on your wings, to deliver them to far places or show them heights unimaginable.

### Larger Frame
You are 1.5x the size of a normal player

### Propel
Launch yourself forward with the aid of your wings and catch the air currents

### Talons & Wings
The way your feet are formed provide no way to wear boots. You always like to move your wings so solid Armor on the Upperbody is a no go for you.

### Flight
Your wings were not made to fly for a long while, and over time you will tire.

### Familiarity
Traditional and frequent usage of long distance weapons has granted you proficiency with them. While flying your Arrows are even more Powerful.

### Soaked Wings
When in water or rain, you are only able to fly for half of time you usually can.
